What is a leverage trading simulator?

A leverage trading simulator lets you open leveraged long and short positions with virtual money at real market prices. Leverage multiplies both your profit and your loss: a 10x position gains or loses 10% of your margin for every 1% the price moves — and if the move goes far enough against you, the position is liquidated and the margin is gone. That mechanic is exactly what wipes out most new leverage traders, and it is exactly what a simulator lets you experience for free.

MarginPad simulates it honestly: the liquidation price is computed with the same isolated-margin formula real futures exchanges use, including a maintenance-margin buffer. A 100x position that would blow up in a real account blows up here too, at the same price.

How far is liquidation at each leverage?

Isolated margin, 0.5% maintenance margin — the adverse price move that liquidates the position:

25x-3.98%An average daily range can liquidate you
50x-1.99%One sharp candle is enough
100x-1.00%Routine noise liquidates you
500x-0.20%Spread plus one tick cluster can do it
1000x-0.10%Effectively a coin flip measured in seconds

Why practice leverage in a simulator first

Leverage is the single most common way new traders lose their first account. Not because they picked the wrong coin — because they never felt how fast 50x moves against them until real money was on the line. In a simulator you can deliberately burn positions at every leverage tier and build an instinct for what each multiplier actually feels like: how tight the stop has to be, how much noise a level absorbs, what funding costs over days.

MarginPad also shows you where the rest of the market gets liquidated: the free liquidation heatmap and live liquidations feed put your practice in context — you can watch a cascade happen and understand why your own liquidation price matters.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a free 100x leverage demo?

Yes. MarginPad lets you practice with any leverage from 1x to 1000x on major crypto pairs (per-symbol caps apply, e.g. 100x-200x on smaller alts) using live prices and a virtual balance. It is free and opens without a sign-up.

Does the simulator actually liquidate positions?

Yes. Positions use the same isolated-margin liquidation formula real futures exchanges use, including a maintenance-margin buffer. At 100x a roughly 1% adverse move liquidates you — in the simulator exactly as it would in a real account.

What leverage should a beginner practice with?

Start at 3x-10x. At 10x your liquidation sits roughly 10% away, which leaves room to learn stop-loss placement. High leverage (50x+) is worth experiencing in a simulator precisely because it teaches how little room there is — a 50x position dies on a 2% move.

Are the prices real?

Yes. Prices stream live from a real exchange feed and your P&L moves tick by tick, so the experience matches a real leveraged account with zero money at risk.

Can I practice leverage on stocks and forex too?

Yes. The same account trades US stocks, forex pairs, stock indices and gold as leveraged positions with realistic per-class leverage caps and fees.

Do I need an account?

No. The simulator opens and trades without a sign-up. A free account is optional and adds leaderboards, missions, XP and rewards.

What is the maximum position size?

Up to $100,000 margin per position, with leverage up to 1000x on majors — large enough to practice sizing the way a funded account would.
